segments.name: Branded Product Program
segments.description: Sells Nathan's Famous hot dog products directly to foodservice operators and to distributors who resell them to foodservice accounts.
segments.evidence: This segment derives revenue principally from the sale of hot dog products either directly to foodservice operators or to various foodservice distributors who resell the products to foodservice operators.

segments.name: Product licensing
segments.description: Earns royalties from third-party licensees selling Nathan's Famous branded products through retail supermarkets, grocery channels and club stores.
segments.evidence: This segment derives revenue, primarily in the form of royalties, from licensing a broad variety of Nathan's Famous branded products, including our hot dogs, frozen crinkle-cut French fries and additional products through retail supermarkets, grocery channels and club stores throughout the United States.

segments.name: Restaurant operations
products: Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs
segments.description: Operates Company-owned restaurants and earns fees and royalties from franchised restaurants, including virtual kitchens.
segments.evidence: This segment derives revenue from the sale of our products at Company-owned restaurants and earns fees and royalties from its franchised restaurants, including its virtual kitchens.

revenueModel.text: The company earns royalties from licensees and franchisees on branded product and restaurant sales, and sells hot dog products directly to foodservice operators and distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn revenue through royalties on products sold by our licensees.
